problem: A failed activity read could show a definitive No new activity notifications message, including after dismissing the last previously loaded item.
resulting_behavior: For enabled, unmuted notifications, loadError explicitly warns that the list may be incomplete; previously loaded items remain visible and dismissible.

reviewed_behavior.reason: The existing warning now explicitly says the list may be incomplete. The definitive empty paragraph is rendered only when no visible terminal notifications remain AND loadError is false. Loaded items keep their original list path.

Rendered event tests dismiss the last known item during failure, retain the incomplete warning and suppress empty copy; successful readback restores a legitimate empty state and a later changed outcome becomes visible.

Labels still come from fixed kind/outcome maps; unknown kinds use Background task. Raw error/result sentinel fields are neither displayed nor copied into dismissal storage. Saved input objects remain unchanged, and the new rendered cases make no fetch calls.

The unchanged caller requires opsProfileId to match the selected profile and keys the component by profileId. Its polling completion checks current profile/disposal. Existing executed tests verify reload persistence, distinct profile dismissal storage and a changed outcome. The component itself relies on that caller-provided profile scope.

Notifications remain disabled by default and opt in only when the saved settings response has enabled===true. Component enabled=false returns no UI. Muting changes only visit-local state; unmuting during failure restores the warning without a false empty result. No preference write or transport action was added.

Existing /operations polling marks failures without clearing successfully read operations, clears the failure flag on success, and schedules the next attempt after 15 seconds. The patch does not change the poller.
